1.consolidated_definition: Trepa, voltereta que se da apoyando la cabeza en el suelo y echando la espalda hacia atrás. También maroma o culivicente.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Somersault that is performed by supporting the head on the ground and arching the back backwards. Also known as a maroma or culivicente.
